capabilities: Extract selected text or heading sections into new notes
Split a whole note at every H1/H2/H3 or from the cursor to the end
Configure profiles combining filename rules, destination folders, templates, and link styles
Undo the last extract, restoring the source note and deleting the created file
Import settings from the Note Refactor plugin as a starting profile
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; supports desktop and mobile. Bilingual UI in English and Japanese following Obsidian's locale. Exposes prefixed CSS classes (nrp-) for customization.
intentEvidence: If you were using the Note Refactor plugin, you can import its settings as a starting profile
problem: Obsidian's built-in note refactoring offers limited control over how extracted notes are named, placed, templated, and linked back to the source.

relations.evidence: Note Refactor import — import your existing Note Refactor settings as a starting profile

summary: Extraction tool that splits selections, heading sections, or note tails into new notes using configurable profiles for filename, folder, and template.
